info.name: Jiwar API v0
info.description:
Jiwar compound-management platform. API v0 is a draft: endpoints are reshaped screen by screen with the design, and every operation carries `x-stability: draft` (ADR 0025).

**Login (tenant accounts):** auth → `Request OTP` → set `otpCode` → `Verify OTP` (stores `loginTicket` and the first account as `loginAccountId`; change it to pick another account) → `Select account` (stores `accessToken`/`refreshToken`). Every request then uses `{{accessToken}}`.

**Platform admin:** set `platformEmail`/`platformPassword` → platform → login (stores `platformAccessToken`).

Path ids are collection variables named after their resource (`ticketId`, `unitId`, `visitId`, ...). Create requests store the new `id` automatically when the response has one.
